intake.note: Georg accepted all six pilot depictions; technical alpha notes retained.

figuren.name: Herr Rostwart
figuren.prompt_auszug:
Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB SLOP RPG TIER-TRIPLET PILOT, NOT six unrelated characters and NOT a scene. ONE1536x1024 landscape TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG sheet, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, EXACTLY SIX standalone full ink-blob depictions. Each ROW shows ONE recognizable identity through THREE evolution/escalation stages; they may also read as brothers/sisters or a gang. TWO identities total: TOP ROW male WARRIOR; BOTTOM ROW female MAGE. Columns LEFT TRASH, MIDDLE COMMON, RIGHT ELITE. Do NOT write headings, labels or any text.
Actual image1 is ORIGINAL ink body/morphology/material STYLE reference; image2 ORIGINAL RPG accessory/material craft reference, NOT edit targets. Invent new subjects; no copying uniform V-brow angry grins or all-red eyeballs. The SAME creature's face, body contour, distinctive teeth, signature color accent and quirk remain recognizable across EACH ROW. Vary pose/acting/equipment, not species. No generated-image style chain.

All SIX are continuous complete FOOTLESS charcoal/deep-violet INK SPLAT MONSTERS, softly rounded thick asymmetrical goo lobes, dark clay body dominant, irregular ivory teeth, modeled lips/lids, subtle purple sheen and fingerprints. UPRIGHT toward camera, full independent outlines, no human torsos/legs/feet, no lying bodies or costume-shaped busts. EVERY visible eye WHITE/IVORY SCLERA, RED IRIS, BLACK PUPIL. Rich original hand-modeled clay, beautiful tactile brass/iron/wood/leather/cloth/glass, soft upper-left studio lighting. Offbeat grotesque cartoon charm, no baby Pixar mascot, faceted/gritty clay or purple camouflage patches.

IMPORTANT progression: NEARLY EQUAL BODY HEIGHT and readable face scale in all THREE columns; tiers1–3 do NOT get larger just because higher level. Equipment sophistication and expressive attitude show progression. Elite is a capable lower-tier Slop, NOT a giant boss or fully armored humanoid. Clothing only short collars, small cap or one shoulder plate, full dark goo base visible. No protruding tongues, circular O mouths, arbitrary extra eyes/limbs or floating emotes. Simple one or two beautifully chunky props per depiction. Comparable occupied cell area, all props/crown/droplets fully fit85percent of each512px cell with at least32px completely transparent margin INSIDE ALL FOUR sides. No overlap, shared props, reaching toward neighbors or cropped equipment.

TOP ROW shared WARRIOR identity: broad compact rounded pear-shaped dark ink body, one tall crown lobe curling to VIEWER LEFT and two short side lobes, big asymmetric eyes with a heavier VIEWER-RIGHT upper lid, one unusually BROAD central ivory lower tooth and ONE crooked small GOLD upper fang when visible. Always SAME faded TEAL neckerchief with a small copper washer clasp, same body/face before gear. Body remains upright.
TOP LEFT TRASH warrior: bare visible curled goo crown, no armor/helmet. Huge startled white/red/black eyes look sideways, awkward crooked UNDERBITE, shoulders/lobes pulled protectively inward without shrinking. Hugs ONE short chunky chipped WOODEN PRACTICE SWORD with a fat square crossguard and ONE small battered plain leather pot-lid-style shield at belly, slightly clumsy grip. Determined but alarmed novice, not injured or dirty patches.
TOP MIDDLE COMMON warrior: SAME blob contour/crown/neckerchief/teeth/lids, small worn brown leather brow cap leaves curling crown visible. Irritated one-eye squint and other eye wide forward, huge crooked SIDEWAYS open-tooth snarl, NO tongue. Confidently holds ONE short blunt rounded IRON SWORD with the SAME broad square guard silhouette as wooden predecessor, and ONE small round wooden buckler with plain copper center boss. Balanced practiced guard, no action scene.
TOP RIGHT ELITE warrior: SAME body height, curled crown, face, teeth and teal neckerchief. One short tarnished brass shoulder plate and a small open copper-rim brow cap, no enclosed face or full armor. Heavy lids, calm assured CLOSED asymmetric GOLD-fang smile, red eyes focused forward. Holds ONE sturdier rounded iron short sword with thick BRASS rim/guard and ONE beautifully rounded small iron buckler with brass center, related silhouettes to COMMON gear. Quiet menace, not another angry grin or giant champion.

BOTTOM ROW shared FEMALE-READ MAGE identity: tall crooked bean/pear ink body, ONE soft purple goo quiff curls toward VIEWER RIGHT, broad wavy lower lobes, two big white/red/black eyes with VIEWER-LEFT eye slightly larger, TWO broad upper ivory teeth and one small lower fang when visible. SAME small soft PLUM witch hat with bent hooked tip and a single TEAL cloth patch, SAME short teal shawl COLLAR with single round amber clasp in all3depictions. Subtle lashes in all3. No long robe/human body. THIS IS ONE FEMALE identity repeated THREE TIMES, not three unrelated women.
BOTTOM LEFT TRASH mage: SAME hat/quiff/body/eyes/teeth/clasp. Shocked confused wide eyes DOWN, small tightly CLENCHED jagged tooth grimace. Holds ONE thick crooked bare wooden wand ending in ONE tiny lilac glass bead tied with fat cream cord; opposite hand clutches ONE little worn plain cloth spell pouch. Awkward startled budding magic, no glow/spells/background effects.
BOTTOM MIDDLE COMMON mage: SAME hat/quiff/body/eyes/teeth/clasp, hat slightly better shaped but same hooked tip/teal patch. One eye squeezed and other wide, wild exuberant SIDEWAYS tooth LAUGH, NO tongue. Holds ONE thicker short crooked wooden STAFF related to TRASH wand, with ONE medium rounded lilac glass orb in a plain brass collar, other arm hugs ONE small closed plum spellbook with blank cover and fat cream pages. Reckless delight, not fear or elite calm.
BOTTOM RIGHT ELITE mage: SAME body height/shape/hat/quiff/eyes/teeth/clasp. Hat remains small and hooked with same patch, just one narrow copper rim and ONE little brass shoulder clasp added, no flowing cloak. Cold knowing half-lidded WHITE/red/black gaze sideways, CLOSED crooked single-fang smile with strong soft lip, contained confidence. Holds ONE beautifully rounded dark wood staff with same crooked outline and larger but still compact lilac glass orb in thick copper collar; other hand cradles SAME type of little plum spellbook, now thick plain copper clasp. No tentacles/giant antlers/glowing eyes or magic FX.

TRUE transparent alpha in all empty space and holes, no colored backdrop/gradient, floor/shadow discs, scenery/scenelet, painted checkerboard, words/numbers/icons/borders. Six whole standalone ink monsters in exact3x2. Visible TWO distinct class identities, each progressing LEFT→RIGHT through3tiers by gear and acting with stable core identity and near-equal body height. Expressive little monster hero journeys; rich handmade clay not human RPG costumes.
